meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把之前交流时确定的方案和说法直接找回来
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常和AI助手连续协作,却不时忘记上次聊过的结论
copy.tagline_en: Bring back the solution discussed in a previous session with one question
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with an AI assistant across sessions and forget past conclusions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能在历史记忆库中搜索之前的会话内容，先返回匹配记录的编号、时间和标题，再按选中的编号获取完整详情。
howto.when: 当用户问到之前其他会话里的内容（而非当前对话），比如“以前修过这个问题吗”“上次是怎么做某件事的”，或需要回顾上周情况时触发。

say.text: 我们上次是怎么解决登录问题的？
say.note: 在历史会话中按关键词搜索相关做法。

say.text: 查一下上周我们处理那个故障时做了什么。
say.note: 按日期筛选取出上周相关记录。

say.text: 我们之前遇到这个报错时是怎么处理的？
say.note: 按报错关键词回溯旧记录。

howto.what_en: Claude can search past-session memories. It returns a filtered table of matching IDs/times/titles, then fetches full details for selected IDs via a layered workflow (search -> timeline -> fetch); raw tool I/O is used only when needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about previous sessions, e.g. "did we already fix this?", "how did we do X last time?", or "what happened last week?" rather than the current conversation.

say_en.text: How did we solve the login issue last time?
say_en.note: Searches past sessions for that solution.

say_en.text: What did we do about that failure last week?
How did we handle this error before?
say_en.note: Triggers a search of past issue records.
